jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Autonomy Capabilities
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of the core autonomy stack that powers the Waabi Driver. This role is central to the success of the business and requires a leader who can bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and real-world commercial requirements. You will provide focused ownership and coordination across teams, ensuring that autonomy efforts are aligned with both technical milestones and driverless launch objectives. You will bring the strategic depth and execution rigor needed to manage complexity at this scale, turning advanced autonomy capabilities into a reliable, commercial product.
You Will...
Define, develop and execute the Autonomy roadmap, aligning core driving capabilities with the company’s driverless and commercial milestones across both the trucking and robotaxi verticals.
Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for autonomy features by translating complex use cases into actionable requirements and establishing performance benchmarks for deploying core driving behaviors in the real world.
Lead cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Design, Research, Simulation, Systems Engineering, Safety, and Commercial teams to define product requirements, manage technical trade-offs, and develop frameworks that make autonomy performance measurable and transparent.
Analyze performance data and feedback from simulation, track, and road testing to develop a comprehensive understanding of system readiness metrics and systematically prioritize issue resolution.
Be a team player who prioritizes trust, transparency, and honesty, leading by example in a high-stakes, safety-critical environment.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as ODD coverage, system readiness, and route viability to make data-driven decisions that accelerate commercialization.
 
Qualifications:
Minimum of 8+ years of experience in a Product Management role, with a proven track record in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex AI/ML systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve dependencies, inform strategic decisions, and evaluate tradeoffs between performance and safety.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with significant experience drafting written strategy documents and slides to communicate complex autonomy concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Demonstrated leadership abilities, with experience driving results and cross-functional alignment in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Exhibits exceptional empathy, fostering a deep understanding of the needs of internal engineering teams, safety drivers, and commercial partners.
Adaptable and versatile, proficient at navigating the shift from R&D-heavy environments to product-driven commercial execution.
Able to maintain progress towards long-term architectural goals while solving immediate operational hurdles.
Passion for autonomous systems, safety-critical software, and building the "brain" of the vehicle that will redefine the future of freight.
Bonus:
Deep understanding of the autonomy stack (e.g. Perception, Prediction, Motion Planning, Localization) and the nuances of autonomous driving operations.
Experience defining operational boundaries and safety validation milestones to drive the successful deployment of autonomous features in complex environments.
Technical experience in autonomous vehicle development or a background in Computer Science/Robotics.
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment tailored for deep-tech research.

The US yearly salary range for this role is: $165,000 - $260,000 USD in addition to competitive perks & benefits. The salary base range is reflective of the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations.  Note: The Company provides additional compensation for employees in this role, including equity incentive awards and an annual performance bonus.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Hardware Platform
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


We are seeking a Product Manager to lead product definition for the hardware platform that carries the Waabi Driver, across autonomous trucks and robotaxi. This is our first dedicated hardware product role, and it requires someone who is grounded in hardware: a product leader who can turn the needs of autonomy, safety, operations, riders, and the public into clear requirements, and who knows enough about hardware to tell an ambitious idea from an impossible one. You will sit at the line between requirements and implementation, laying out scenarios, testing ideas in mock-ups and vehicles, partnering with hardware engineering on high-level solutions, and representing product with our OEM and supplier partners until the product is right end-to-end.
You will...
Own product requirements for Waabi's hardware platform across trucks and robotaxi, turning field and integration feedback into requirements for future revisions and new vehicle platforms.
Define how our vehicles interact with the people around them, including riders, law enforcement, first responders, and the public. This covers exterior communication and signaling, cabin monitoring and security, in-cabin safety, and resilience to tampering and vandalism.
Lead product definition for new hardware programs before engineering kickoff, turning real-world scenarios into requirements with clear acceptance criteria and a plan to verify and validate each one.
Bring an industrial design and human factors perspective to physical touchpoints like displays, lighting, reach, and controls, and validate them hands-on in mock-ups and real vehicles.
Build trusted relationships with OEM and supplier partners, understanding their constraints and processes and keeping requirements aligned across organizations.
Represent hardware credibly in cross-functional product decisions about what's possible, what's costly, and what's out of scope.
Qualifications:
A hardware background, through an engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, systems, or similar) or equivalent hands-on experience, deep enough to earn engineering teams' trust while you work at the requirements level.
8+ years of experience in product management, hardware product, or systems engineering roles on physical products, ideally in automotive, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex consumer hardware.
A track record of taking hardware from concept to production, with an understanding of how requirements evolve across prototype and sample stages.
Industrial design experience, through formal training or close work with industrial designers on shipped products, and strong instincts for HMI and human factors.
Strong requirements writing skills. You can turn a messy real-world scenario into a clear, testable requirement, with acceptance criteria and a verification method such as test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration.
Experience building working relationships with OEMs and suppliers, and an understanding of how they develop, source, and deliver hardware.
A commitment to trust, transparency, and honesty in a safety-critical environment.
Willingness to be on site regularly for mock-ups, vehicle evaluations, and testing.
Bonus/nice to have:
Experience on autonomous vehicles or robotaxi, especially rider experience, external communication with road users, or first responder interaction.
Familiarity with automotive development processes such as APQP, PPAP, and A/B/C sample phases.
Exposure to functional safety and AV safety standards such as ISO 26262, SOTIF (ISO 21448), or UL 4600, or to vehicle regulations.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager, Platform Integration
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


The Lead Technical Program Manager - Platform Integration owns program-level execution across Waabi's platform programs, with a focus on cross-functional integration between hardware development, onboard software, embedded systems, autonomy, safety, and operations. You are the connective tissue between teams that operate on fundamentally different cadences: embedded software with kanban-based delivery, autonomy research with probabilistic timelines, and safety validation with methodical gate-based requirements. You will surface where those cadences collide, identify gaps in requirements and execution, map the critical path accurately, and ensure risks are visible and owned so we maintain velocity and deliver on time.
 
You Will..
Define and maintain integrated platform program plans covering key milestones, cross-team dependencies, and ensure on-time delivery.
Ensure all stakeholder inputs are captured and integrated into program plans before design commitments lock in.
Build and enforce dependency maps across Hardware, Software, Systems and Safety, and Ops, identify the critical path, and ensure every dependency has an owner and an ETA.
Own reporting into executive forums. Surface risks early with data-backed Path to Green options, not just status updates.
Track system VnV and overall test campaigns, ensuring test coverage, sign-off readiness, and milestone alignment across teams.
Build cross-functional roadmaps that give hardware, software, and autonomy a shared line of sight on interdependencies and sequencing.
Champion tools to capture the single source of truth for program work, ensuring consistency across programs.
Build scalable tracking mechanisms and systematic processes that work at fleet scale.
 
Technical breadth. Ask the right questions, spot unrealistic assumptions in a plan, and know when a dependency is a real blocker versus a process gap. You can engage with engineers across hardware, embedded software, autonomy, and safety without needing to be a domain expert in any one area.
 
Self-starter who builds processes from scratch. Build processes and iterate based on what actually works and impose structure without creating overhead.
 
Cross-functional influencer. Work on highly cross functional programs spanning embedded software, onboard software, hardware, autonomy, safety, and operations. 
 
Risk-first mindset. Surface problems early, escalate without hesitation, and always arrive with options. You can dive deep and bring clarity to status updates and a Path to Green.
 
Comfort with ambiguity. Thrive in bringing clarity and structure to ambiguity and convert ambitious goals into programs with hard success criteria, DRIs, and trackable milestones.
 
 
Required Qualifications:
6+ years of technical program management experience, with a strong focus on cross-functional hardware, software and systems integration programs.
Demonstrated experience working across teams with meaningfully different development cadences (e.g., robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, IoT, or defense systems).
Proven ability to build cross-functional program structure from scratch: dependency maps, risk registries, executive reporting, and milestone tracking.
Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp one-pager for an executive audience and facilitate a working-level dependency review with engineers in the same week.
Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS).
Hands-on experience with program tracking tools like Jira, Asana and Microsoft Project.
Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve program visibility, reduce manual overhead, or accelerate decision-making.
Preferred Qualifications:
Familiarity with embedded systems and software development and the constraints that come with it.
Familiarity with ML development workflows and an understanding of how model iteration cadences interact with hardware and software delivery timelines. Experience working alongside ML or AI research teams in a program capacity is a plus.
Experience establishing or scaling a triage process for field issues across engineering teams.
Background in systems engineering, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline.

jobs.title: Staff Commercial Product Manager, Trucking
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


About the Role
Waabi's Commercial Product team defines and delivers the end-to-end commercial product that makes autonomous trucking deployable, scalable, and valuable to customers. We sit between autonomy, operations, business development, and customers, turning driverless capability into a real-world product that can be launched, sold, operated, and scaled.

We are hiring a Staff Commercial Product Manager to own critical commercial product workstreams that bring the Waabi Driver to market. This person will define the operating models, service capabilities, partner workflows, and customer-facing product requirements required to bring the Waabi Driver to market and scale it from commercial pilots into a broader autonomous trucking network.

This is not a traditional software PM role. You will help define how autonomous trucking commercialization works in the real world: how trucks launch and land, how missions are monitored, how exceptions are handled, how customers are onboarded, how partners integrate, how sites are qualified, and how the product scales.
 
What You'll Do

You will own high-impact commercial product workstreams end-to-end. Near-term areas of focus may include Command Center / fleet oversight, Life of a Load (end-to-end service delivery), launch and land operations, AV hubs and customer launch sites, Waabi Services (maintenance, inspections, roadside, data offload, mission support, customer operations), partner and ecosystem integration, and pilot-to-scale playbooks.

Across those workstreams, you will:
Define the "how" behind novel autonomous trucking challenges through process mapping, operating model design, requirements definition, and cross-functional alignment.
Translate customer, operations, autonomy, and business needs into clear product requirements and deployment plans.
Build structured frameworks for site readiness, service design, partner integration, customer onboarding, launch readiness, and operational scalability.
Build repeatable pilot-to-scale playbooks that move customers, lanes, and sites from pilot to qualified, mature, and driverless-ready deployments.
Lead cross-functional workstreams with autonomy, operations, engineering, business development, safety, legal, and external partners.
Drive workshops with internal teams and external partners, including agenda design, decision framing, progress tracking, and follow-through.
Identify key tradeoffs across customer value, autonomy readiness, operational complexity, cost, speed, and long-term scalability.
Inform partnership requirements and operating models with OEMs, customers, service providers, and facility partners, in close partnership with BD.
Produce executive-ready decision memos, operating playbooks, and product artifacts for your workstreams.
Work closely with engineering and autonomy teams to understand technical constraints, risks, readiness levels, and product implications.
Communicate clearly with technical, operational, commercial, and executive audiences.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means you have helped Waabi move from promising autonomous capability to a commercially deployable trucking product. Specifically, you will have:
Turned ambiguous commercial problems into clear product requirements, operating models, and execution plans.
Created scalable playbooks that reduce friction for future customers, lanes, sites, and partners.
Helped internal teams make faster, better trade-off decisions.
Built trust with operations, autonomy, engineering, commercial teams, and external partners.
Improved Waabi’s ability to launch, operate, support, and scale driverless trucking missions.
Created artifacts and systems that become foundational to Waabi’s commercial deployment model.

Qualifications
Required
8+ years in product management, operations, strategy, or program leadership in a complex technical/operational environment (autonomous vehicles, trucking, freight, logistics, robotics, or other physical-AI deployment)
Demonstrated experience standing up an operating model from scratch in a physical-world business — services + workflows + tools, not just software
Track record of designing, launching, or scaling complex B2B products, services, programs, or operating models
Strong systems thinking and first-principles judgment — able to break ambiguous problems into clear frameworks, requirements, decisions, and execution plans
Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives without formal authority
Executive-grade written and verbal communication
High EQ, low ego, and bias toward ownership and action

Strongly Preferred
Experience with B2B enterprise customers, strategic partnerships, OEMs, or service provider ecosystems
Experience designing operational processes, customer onboarding flows, service models, or scaled deployment playbooks
Zero-to-one product or program experience at an early-stage or scaling startup
Direct experience in autonomous trucking, freight tech, or AV commercialization (vs. adjacent physical-AI domains)
Track record of owning end-to-end outcomes, not just deliverables (e.g., business unit, product line, or service area ownership).

Nice to have
Experience working with internal or outsourced operations teams
Experience standing up or scaling a Command Center, NOC, fleet operations function, or similar 24/7 operating environment
MBA
